subject: Multi-entity remittance — invoice guidance & ACH setup
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:12:00Z
Subject: Invoice 12487 — remit guidance and split-entity question

Hi Elaine,

Hope you had a good long weekend. Attached is invoice_12487.pdf for the API usage from Aug 1–31. Quick ask on remit routing: Novacare appears to remit from two legal entities (Novacare US and Novacare EU). Can you confirm if this invoice should be paid to our US entity (ACH in USD) or split across entities?

If you plan to split, what proportions should we expect (e.g., 100% US, or 60/40)? Also flagging two operational items so we can avoid payment delay:
- If paying via ACH to our US bank, we need a remittance advice with invoice number and exact amount.
- For any EU payments, we typically require the paying entity's VAT ID to present a zero-rated invoice or to confirm tax handling.

I've attached the invoice and our W-9 stub for AP teams to validate. If you prefer, we can issue two invoices (one to each legal entity) — let me know and we'll split and resend by EOD.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Accounts Receivable Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: invoice_12487.pdf, W-9_redwood_2026.pdf
From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacare AP <ap@novacare.com>, Thomas Berg <t.berg@novacare-eu.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 12487 — remit guidance and split-entity question

Thanks Marissa — and thanks for the quick turnaround on the invoice.

Short answers: Novacare can do a split payment, but I need AP to confirm the mechanics. CC'ing our AP (ap@novacare.com) and Thomas (EU ops) to provide bank/payment details. A couple of follow-ups for your team:
- Please confirm the legal name and tax ID you want payment made to for the US ACH (we need a formal W-9 on file).
- For the EU portion, please confirm the billed entity and provide the appropriate VAT invoice details (we require supplier VAT ID to route as B2B).

If Redwood can provide two invoices (one addressed to Novacare US LLC, one to Novacare EU Ltd) that will speed processing. If not, AP may process as a single wire and allocate internally, but that adds reconciliation steps.

Elaine
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Novacare Health
elaine.morris@novacare.com

From: Novacare AP <ap@novacare.com>

Date: 2026-09-04T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 12487 — remit guidance and split-entity question

Hi all,

We can execute payment by ACH to the US account if Redwood provides the W-9 and confirms the correct receiving entity/legal name. Our payment window for ACH is 9/10 — if we receive confirmation and remittance instructions by 9/08 end of day, we will schedule the ACH for 9/10.

If Redwood requires payment to an EU bank (EUR), we will need IBAN and beneficiary details; we can do a separate wire for that portion. For split payments: we prefer separate invoices to each legal entity to simplify our GL posting.

Bank details for our side if you require any PO remittance fields: ap@novacare.com
Terms/notes:
- ACH cutoff: 9/10 15:00 UTC for USD ACH on the next settlement date.
- For wire (EUR): lead time 2 business days after receiving invoice and beneficiary info.

Please attach W-9 and supplier VAT ID so we can complete onboarding checklist.

Regards,
Novacare Accounts Payable
ap@novacare.com

(Attachment suggested: supplier_tax_form_request.pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 12487 — remit guidance and split-entity question

Marissa / Karthik —

I tracked Novacare's response. Proposed approach to minimize friction:
1) Issue two invoices: Invoice A (US entity) for 60% of total, Invoice B (EU entity) for 40%.
2) Attach explicit remittance instructions on each invoice: bank account, ACH routing, IBAN for EU, and a single-line description that AP can paste into their payment reference ("INV12487-US" / "INV12487-EU").
3) Send the W-9 to AP and request Novacare's VAT ID from Thomas for EU posting.

Karthik — can you confirm the split (60/40) is OK with finance and confirm the exact legal names to print on the invoices? If so, Marissa will re-issue two PDFs and I'll draft the short payment instructions doc (split-invoice-instructions.pdf).

—Ben
Collections Lead
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Invoice 12487 — remit guidance and split-entity question

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

1) We will issue two invoices: Invoice 12487-US (60% — USD) and Invoice 12487-EU (40% — EUR). Files will be attached to this thread within 1 business hour.
2) Action for Novacare AP: please confirm the exact VAT ID and billed entity name for the EU payment (Thomas — can you confirm?). Also please confirm the expected payment dates for each portion once you have internal approval.
3) AP: once you receive the W-9 (attached) and the two invoices, please send a remittance confirmation email with payment amounts and expected settlement dates. That will help us close the month cleanly.

Attached to this message: split-invoice-instructions.pdf (how to reference each invoice in your payment portal), invoice_12487.pdf (original single invoice for reference), W-9_redwood_2026.pdf.

If you prefer us to re-weight the split (e.g., 50/50) rather than 60/40, say so and we'll adjust before sending the final PDFs.

Appreciate the coordination — reach out if AP needs a different file format (CSV remittance) or a PO mapping.

Best,
